newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on a weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on a weak yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures extended gains to end higher across the board on Monday, as the yen's weakness against the dollar and firmer overseas markets stimulated private investors' buying, traders said.
Prices ranged from 2.8 yen to 4.7 yen per kg higher. Benchmark February finished 2.8 yen higher at 145.7 yen.
After prices opened firmer, prices edged up gradually as the dollar crept towards 109 yen in late Tokyo trade.
Activity was buoyant. "Sentiment will be boosted after the spot September contract reached 140 yen before the close," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
